errors.text_span: x 轴标签为标记评分
errors.evidence: The x-axis label in the chart is '漏标率' (Missing label rate), not '标记评分' (Marking score).
While most x-axis tick intervals are 0.1, the last interval is from 0.5 to 0.585. Stating the interval is uniformly 0.1 is an over-generalization.
The marker for the red line is a star/asterisk, not a triangle.
All reported values for the red line are incorrect. For example, at x=0, the value is close to 0, not 0.033. At x=0.1, it is approx 0.03. At x=0.585, it is approx 0.20, not 0.129.

All reported values for the blue line are incorrect. For example, at x=0, the value is approx 0.02, not 0.033. At x=0.1, it is approx 0.035, not 0.066. The description also incorrectly states the line rises from x=0.1 to x=0.2, when it actually decreases.
All reported values for the green line are incorrect. For example, at x=0, the value is 0, not 0.033. At x=0.585, it is approx 0.075, not 0.092.
The description fails to mention the legend that associates each line with its corresponding method name ('Teacher', 'Self-Training', 'PST').
The description omits the data points at x=0.5 for all three lines, jumping directly from describing x=0.4 to x=0.585.
